intro.zh: 本次重点修复 Windows 通用设置卡死，并改进内置模型的稳定性与问题诊断。
intro.en: This release fixes frozen General settings on Windows and improves built-in model stability and diagnostics.

items.zh: 修复 Windows 点击通用设置后，按钮无法点击、页面无法滚动的问题。
items.en: Fixed General settings on Windows becoming unresponsive to clicks and scrolling.

items.zh: 黑名单改为编辑结束、离开输入框时保存，避免输入过程中刷新页面和丢失焦点。
items.en: Blacklist edits now save when you leave the text box, avoiding page refreshes and lost focus while typing.

items.zh: 调整 Windows 内置模型运行库，避开已确认会在部分处理器上导致进程退出的 CPU 变体。
items.en: Adjusted the Windows built-in model runtime to avoid a CPU variant confirmed to terminate the process on affected processors.

items.zh: 补充模型输出被拒绝时的诊断信息，并修正 Windows 测试诊断的中文编码。
items.en: Added diagnostics for rejected model output and corrected Chinese text encoding in Windows test diagnostics.
